metadata.description: Real confocal NLOS measurements of an outdoor building scene. 128×128 scan, 2m×2m relay wall, 32ps bins, 10 min exposure.

_info.metric_note: NCC and NRMSE computed against original authors reference f-k reconstruction

operator_fixtures.scope: Published toy operator arrays only; not the 512x128x128 inverse problem.

axes.convention: Source volume_axes uses inclusive linspace endpoints; the forward model uses half-bin voxel centers. These are distinct conventions.

saved_peak.note: Maximum is in last depth plane; do not infer independent object-depth accuracy.

limits: No model, agent, full-size inverse reconstruction, Docker, runtime install or historical rewrite.
Baseline copy is an oracle/no-op control; same-array scores are not fresh task execution or independent ground truth.
Original upstream MATLAB swaps lateral axes and zeros the last eleven depth planes before display/output; the released Python solver does not. Original-author byte equivalence is not established.
Retained metrics lack boundary keys. Source main.py could create them on execution, but was not run and no pass is claimed.
Metadata raw depth range 9.8304 m is reduced to source displayed 2.4576 m after 512-bin crop.
Full data use follows original authors' academic/non-commercial license; benchmark MIT declaration does not replace it.

findings: Native raw shape is (128,128,2048), meas float32 and tofgrid float64. README labels tofgrid float32. Metadata is available from the pinned HF path but is absent from the Git tree and asset manifest.

Selected LocalRunner.start copies baseline_reference.npz in all L1-L3 because data/ is included. All install commands were intercepted. Docker source mounts whole task read-only at /workspace_src; no Docker execution or privacy claim.
Saved fk, fk_reference.npy and baseline reconstruction[0] are numerically and bytewise equal as arrays. This is saved-output agreement, not independent scene ground truth or fresh solver success.

Active generic scorer selects evaluation/reference_outputs/reconstruction.npz ahead of data/baseline_reference.npz. Its NCC is cosine and its NRMSE retains amplitude. Source main.py centers NCC and max-normalizes volumes first.
A half-amplitude control retains generic NCC 1 but has NRMSE 0.020574; native normalized metrics remain NCC 1 and NRMSE 0. A 2D front projection fails the expected 3D output shape.
Shipped reference_outputs/metrics.json has no ncc_boundary or nrmse_boundary. main.py contains proposed 0.9 and 0.1 boundaries but was not executed; current pass status is None.
Three native histograms use exact calibration shifts -748, -816 and -903 bins, then crop to512 bins. Full-size f-k migration is not run. The 16x8x8 published solver fixture agrees within 4.62e-14.
Metadata 9.8304 m depth extent describes2048 bins. Source volume_axes for512 cropped bins spans0 to2.4576 m inclusively. Forward-model half-bin centers and source display coordinates are distinct.

Original MATLAB permutes lateral axes and zeros the last11 depth planes before output. Python adaptation preserves the last plane, where the released saved volume peaks. No claim of original-author byte equivalence or independently validated scene depth.
